mpo: Only JPEG/JPG-named MPO inputs; process primary frame zero, apply orientation, omit metadata from bounded PNG upload; preserve original bytes.
limits: Existing input byte/dimension/pixel/decompression checks and strict single-frame PNG outputs unchanged. No automatic resizing or limit increase.
recovery: Fresh matching snapshot, same request identity, local input-validation provenance and zero attempt rows required for transactional FAILED-to-READY reconsideration. Preserve historical failure audit.
visibility: Console text optional with legacy JSON default; active configs select text. File logs remain JSON.
heartbeat: 15-second configurable bounded interval; parent-process ticker reused by idle/rate waits and provider join callbacks. No background SQLite threads or invented percentages.
privacy: No photo pixels or EXIF details in logs; no credentials/prompt/token contents.
validation: Synthetic MPO fixtures and fake providers for regressions; real photo local decode/normalization only before live permission.
existingBehavior: Keep confirmed tenant, model, endpoint, two-RPM pacing, three attempts, and no replay of any previously sent image.
